description: Implementation of SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) scheduler for 5G NR, managing SRS resource allocation, UE configuration, and positioning measurement requests.

classes.name: srs_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Class responsible for managing SRS resource scheduling, UE configuration, and positioning requests in a 5G NR network.

methods.name: create_srs_pdu
methods.description: Helper function to generate an SRS info PDU for a given SRS resource.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling for a given slot, allocating SRS opportunities.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler, clearing internal states and pending requests.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE configuration to the scheduler.

methods.name: add_ue_to_grid
methods.description: Adds a UE's SRS resources to the scheduling grid, optionally during reconfiguration.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE's SRS resources from the scheduling grid.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures a UE's SRS resources based on new configuration.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_request
methods.description: Handles incoming positioning measurement requests, scheduling SRS accordingly.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_stop
methods.description: Stops positioning measurement procedures for a given RNTI.

methods.name: schedule_slot_srs
methods.description: Schedules SRS opportunities for a specific slot.

methods.name: schedule_updated_ues_srs
methods.description: Schedules SRS for UEs that have been recently added or reconfigured.

methods.name: allocate_srs_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates an SRS opportunity in a slot for a specific SRS resource.

methods.name: add_resource
methods.description: Adds an SRS resource to the periodic slot wheel for a UE.

methods.name: rem_resource
methods.description: Removes an SRS resource from the periodic slot wheel for a UE.

methods.name: get_ue_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves the UE configuration for a given RNTI.
